memory_candidates.content: A regex-only, file-level (not call-site-level) content lint can produce a false positive when a stale doc comment merely mentions a now-migrated helper's old function name, if an unrelated literal elsewhere in the same file also matches the check's other half. Fix by rewording the comment away from BOTH the old and the new literal function-name tokens (a generic description), not by swapping one literal for the other -- swapping just moves the over-count to a different check (e.g. a resolve/declare call-count-balance check) that has the same file-level blind spot.
